title: Mixing: Temporary Secretary, On The Way, Mr H Atom, Bogey Wobble by Paul McCartney | 1979
content:
Studio Three, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Eddie Klein

The second mixing session for Paul McCartney’s McCartney II album took place on 26 September 1979.

Although intended as rough mixes, the stereo mix of ‘Temporary Secretary’ and ‘On The Way’ made on this day were used on the album. McCartney also mixed the outtakes ‘Mr H Atom’ and ‘Bogey Wobble’.
